item.title: [Resolved] Live Deployment
item.description:
The Live Service is currently in maintenance to deploy Star Citizen Alpha 4.10.2.

This maintenance window is not expected to exceed 4 hours.

New connections to the game have been disabled.

Servers will go offline at 1030 UTC.

Players are strongly advised to safely stow their vehicles and equipment before logging off in advance of server shutdown.

[2026-10-09 Updates]

1000 UTC - Initial Notice, Matchmaking disabled.

1400 UTC - 🚀 Star Citizen Alpha 4.10.2-live.12881860 available for download, Servers online.
